fireworks.label: 🎆 Fireworks
fireworks.tooltip: Both teams’ {segment}s usually go Over. ‘Usually’ = 60%+ of their games, 5+ played.
fireworks.tooltip_btts: In both teams’ {segment}s, both teams usually score. ‘Usually’ = 60%+ of their games, 5+ played.

lockdown.label: 🔒 Lockdown
lockdown.tooltip: Both teams’ {segment}s usually go Under. ‘Usually’ = 60%+ of their games, 5+ played.
lockdown.tooltip_btts: In both teams’ {segment}s, usually not both teams score. ‘Usually’ = 60%+ of their games, 5+ played.

mismatch.label: 🥊 Mismatch
mismatch.tooltip: One team usually wins the {segment}, the other usually loses it.

tug_of_war.label: 🪢 Tug of war
tug_of_war.tooltip: One team’s {segment}s usually go Over, the other’s usually go Under.
tug_of_war.tooltip_btts: In one team’s {segment}s both teams usually score; in the other’s, usually not both teams score.

streaks.section: Teams on a run of 3 or more straight in the opening segment, counted from their most recent game. A tie or push ends a streak.
streaks.colors: Win and loss streaks run green to red. Over/Under and Yes/No streaks get darker the longer they run.

record_line.tooltip: Record betting this trend this season, how often it won, how often the same bet won across all games, and profit at 1 unit per bet.

ats_L.title: Didn’t cover the {segment} spread
ats_L.meaning: The team failed to beat the {segment} spread. Pushes are left out.

ats_W.title: Covered the {segment} spread
ats_W.meaning: The team beat the {segment} spread. Pushes are left out.

btts_N.title: Not both teams score
btts_N.meaning: At least one team was held scoreless in the {segment}.

ml_L.title: Lost the {segment}
ml_L.meaning: The team trailed after the {segment}. Ties count as games played.

ml_W.title: Won the {segment}
ml_W.meaning: The team led after the {segment}. Ties count as games played.

rfi_N.title: NRFI
rfi_N.meaning: No runs scored in the 1st inning.

rfi_Y.title: YRFI
rfi_Y.meaning: At least one run scored in the 1st inning.

total_O.title: {segment} Over
total_O.meaning: The {segment} went over its total. Pushes are left out.

total_U.title: {segment} Under
total_U.meaning: The {segment} stayed under its total. Pushes are left out.

tips.fade: Fade means bet the other side.
